summary: Lists become connection variables (ansible_become, ansible_become_method, ansible_become_user, ansible_become_password, ansible_common_remote_group) for per-host settings, with an inventory example connecting as manager and becoming root.
questions: How do I set become per host in inventory?
How do I store the become password for a host?
How do I connect as one user and run tasks as root?

answer_card.title: become connection variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible_become`: whether to escalate (overrides the directive)
- `ansible_become_method`
- `ansible_become_user` (doesn't imply `ansible_become: true`)
- `ansible_become_password` (use Vault to avoid plain text)
- `ansible_common_remote_group`: group to `chgrp` temp files to if `setfacl` and `chown` fail (2.10+)

```text
webserver ansible_user=manager ansible_become=true
```

Become plugins may also have plugin-specific options.
